# 610: Børskrakk og risiko med Peter Warren

**Feed**: pengepodden-no  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Pengepodden episode with guest Peter Warren, investment director at H100 and a former trader and fund manager, about stock market crashes, risk and how central-bank bailouts since the financial crisis have created moral hazard. He sees a warning sign in hyperscaler credit default swaps (CDS, the cost of insuring their debt), which are up about 60% this year to around 170bp. Index options remain cheap, which he compares to the divergence seen before 2008. Warren still finds the market remarkably resilient given the geopolitical backdrop. He mentions possibly asymmetric upside in copper and European gas, and explains H100's approach of earning yield on its bitcoin holdings through arbitrage.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hyperscaler CDS is up about 60% this year to around 170bp and Oracle is extreme. Professional money is buying protection while retail stays calm.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Warren sees widening CDS on the hyperscalers, some of whose bonds now trade at high-yield levels, as a divergence similar to the credit-equity gap before 2008. Oracle is called the most extreme. This is a risk warning, not an explicit sell call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler CDS spreads tighten back
- if AI capex financing concerns ease

> *"forsikringen på hyperscalerne, og da tar jeg ut Oracle som er ganske ekstrem, er på en kurv av disse, er nå på nesten 170 basispunkter"*
